newsitem.title: UK: Ethical to seek UK stock market listing.
newsitem.headline: Ethical to seek UK stock market listing.

text.p: Ethical Holdings Plc, the British-based drug-development company listed on the U.S. Nasdaq exchange, said on Monday it was to seek a listing on the London Stock Exchange. In a statement the company said the listing would be achieved through an institutional placing, with Baring Brothers acting as sponsors and HSBC James Capel as broker to the flotation.

Ethical develops oral and skin patch drugs using specialist technology. Its main drugs are focused on cardiovascular disease, hormone replacement therapy (HRT) and pain management. Ethical chairman and chief executive officer Geoffrey Guy said the listing would enable the company to "reach a wider base of investors," as well as boosting development of its product portfolio. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
